newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SINCLAIR TO STAY WITH QPR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SINCLAIR TO STAY WITH QPR.

text.p: Highly-rated Queen's Park Rangers winger Trevor Sinclair said on Tuesday he would remain with the English first division club.
"I am now delighted to say that I have withdrawn my transfer request and that I am currently in negotiation with regard to signing a new contract," Sinclair said.
Sinclair, who had been valued as high as 8 million pounds ($13.2 million), will be back in a Rangers shirt on Sunday when they travel to Selhurst Park for a London derby with Crystal Palace.
